description: This file defines a fallback mechanism for certain self-inverse tensor operations in PyTorch, handling in-place, out-of-place, and view operations with special handling for tensors with specific 'math bits' set (conjugate and negative). It includes class definitions, method implementations, and detailed logic for managing tensor states during fallback execution.

classes.name: MathOpFallback
classes.description: A class providing fallback implementations for self-inverse tensor operations, managing tensor states and dispatching operations with special handling for tensors with specific 'math bits' set.

methods.name: is_bit_set
methods.description: Pure virtual method to determine if a specific tensor has a particular 'math bit' set.

methods.name: fallback_impl
methods.description: Implements fallback logic for tensor operations, handling out-of-place, in-place, and out= operations with tensor state management.
